description: This file defines the Smarty_Autoloader class responsible for autoloading Smarty classes and plugins, including registration methods for backward compatibility and SPL autoload registration.

classes.name: Smarty_Autoloader
classes.description: Class responsible for autoloading Smarty core classes and plugins, with methods for registration and autoload handling.

methods.name: registerBC
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with backward compatibility, optionally prepending it.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the Smarty autoloader, with optional prepend.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Handles the autoloading of classes based on class name, including core classes and plugins.
